title: Christ The Lord is Risen Today
lyrics_original: Christ, the Lord, is risen today,
Sons of men and angels say,
Raise your joys and triumphs high,
Sing, ye heavens, and earth, reply,
Fought the fight, the battle won,
Death in vain forbids His rise,
Where, O death, is now thy sting?
Dying once He now doth save,
Soar we now where Christ hath led,
Made like Him, like Him we rise,
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies,
Hail, the Lord of earth and Heaven,
Praise to Thee by both be given,

bible_verses.english: He isn’t here, but has risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee, saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?

For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures, that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, I praise You today for Your glorious resurrection and the endless hope it brings to my life. Thank You that the battle over sin and death is won, and that Love’s redeeming work is truly complete. Help me to live in the reality of Your victory every day, letting my heart continually overflow with joy and praise. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: The resurrection of Jesus Christ is the ultimate declaration that love has conquered sin and death forever. When we sing 'Alleluia,' we join both heaven and earth in celebrating a victory that was won on our behalf. Christ’s finished work gives us unbreakable hope and a reason to rejoice regardless of our present circumstances. Today, let your heart echo this triumphant praise, resting securely in the gift of His eternal life.
